units.source_text: “哦，好极了……吃森嘉豆腐，我固然高兴；

en.t: Oh, that is wonderful... Of course I am happy to eat Morika tofu;

units.source_text: 可千重子来了，我更高兴啊！

en.t: but I am even happier that Chieko has come!

units.source_text: 待到傍晚，好让爸爸松松脑筋，构思一幅精彩的图案好不好……”

en.t: Let us wait until evening, so Father can clear his head and think up a wonderful design, shall we..."
